fusions.name: Gathering Arms
fusions.desc: Sweeps your long arms through a line 6 tiles long ahead of you for 3 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward. It deals 12 damage to each one it catches and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Bundled and Wrung
fusions.desc: Only usable on a target at or below 25% health. You bundle it up in both arms and wring it for 26 damage, leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and make it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Everyone Onto Me
fusions.desc: A challenge that drags up to 5 enemies within 7 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Knotted Tally
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a mark builds on the target, up to 5. When it reaches 5, they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 20% of your weapon damage per mark (102% at full). Unfed, a mark fades every 4 seconds.
